stage1.impression: A quiet night shopfront with a believable warm room behind the glass and a nice recessed door with its pool of light. It still reads as CG: the facade, pavement and sky are untextured near-black planes, the transom strip is a cold fluorescent bar that fights the 2400 K room, there is a denoiser smear in the lower centre pane, and the name on the glass reads as a flat mint-and-peach decal rather than gold leaf. No product or speaker colour reads anywhere in the frame.

blocking_9: The street, kerb and facade carry real material detail (wet asphalt or concrete with reflections, painted or stucco facade texture) instead of crushed flat planes: bottom band lum_median above 6 with visible texture, crush_pct below 25
One coherent night light world: street lamps visibly lighting the facade and pavement at 4000 K against the warm 2400 K interior, with no cold-white transom bar
The name on the glass reads as gilded leaf (warm metallic, specular, slightly translucent from behind), not a flat two-tone decal
No denoiser smear or blotching anywhere on the glass or curtains
The room's one colour, an Ember speaker or its glow, is readable through the glass so the frame says what this bar is
Glass reads as glass: faint street reflections and a sheen on the panes

defects.what: Denoiser smear / ghost blotch on the lower centre pane over the curtains; the vertical folds dissolve into a blurred patch
EARF letters read as a flat mint-and-peach decal, not gold leaf; no metallic specular, RGB median 162,167,132, delta-E 16.9 against a gold #C9A24A
Transom lit by cold neutral-white strip bars (p95 228) that look like office fluorescents and clash with the warm room
Pavement and kerb are a crushed untextured plane (lum_median 1.0, crush 57%): no ground, no reflections, no street lamp pools
The facade above the transom is a featureless blue-black slab with CG-clean edges
The left edge is pure black (crush 96%): no neighbouring building, no context
The recessed door is almost black (lum_median 1.0); the door and vestibule read as a void
The glass has no reflection or sheen; it reads as an open hole in the wall
The room's upper half is a flat orange wash with little modelling; no speaker colour visible

changes.problem: The street lamps do nothing: the pavement and facade are crushed to black, so the building has no material, no ground and no night world.

evidence.measured: lum_median 1.0, crush_pct 56.9; facade top band lum_median 6.4

change.to: 600 W each, placed 4-5 m above the far kerb and about 2 m in front of the camera's side, one raking the facade from the left at a low angle; street material: wet dark asphalt, roughness 0.25, with a 3 cm concrete kerb

changes.expected: Pools of cool light on the pavement and a raking gradient across the facade, wet reflections of the warm windows in the street; bottom band median about 8-15 with texture

changes.problem: The denoiser has smeared the curtain folds in the lower centre pane into a ghost blotch.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x crop: vertical folds blur into an unstructured patch, unlike the crisp folds at 620-820

change.to: 1024 samples, adaptive 0.005, denoiser with albedo and normal passes (OpenImageDenoise, prefilter Accurate)

changes.expected: Curtain folds stay continuous across the whole lower band; local contrast in the centre pane matches the right pane

changes.problem: The name on the glass reads as a flat pastel decal, not gold leaf.

evidence.measured: RGB median 162,167,132; delta-E 16.9 against #C9A24A; no specular variation

change.to: emission 0; metallic 1.0, base #C9A24A, roughness 0.18, with a fine crinkle normal map and a thin dark outline; let the street lamp give it a specular glint

changes.expected: Letters read as warm gilt with a highlight from the street and a darker translucent back toward the room

changes.problem: The transom strip lights read as cold office fluorescents and break the warm palette.

evidence.measured: p95 227.8, neutral white; the room behind is r 49 g 16 b 1

change.to: 2400 K, half the strength, diffused behind the transom glass so it glows rather than shows a bar

changes.expected: The transom glows amber like the room; no bright white line across the top of the frame

changes.problem: The room's only colour, the Ember speakers, does not appear, so the shopfront could be any bar.

evidence.measured: no red speaker hue anywhere in the windows; the room is a uniform orange wash

change.to: about [-8.5, 3.0, 1.45] aimed so that one Ember speaker in the listening room is visible through the glass above the café curtains, in the right third; raise the Ember speaker area lamps from 3.0 to 6.0 W/m2 so it reads from the street

changes.expected: A small but unmistakable red glowing cabinet through the glass, the frame's single colour accent

changes.problem: The facade and window glass have no material: the building is a flat slab and the glass a hole.

evidence.measured: lum_range 35.9 with crush 46%; no reflections on the panes

change.setting: street and facade materials, shopfront glass
change.from: flat dark painted planes; clear glass with no visible reflection
change.to: painted wood or stucco facade with a fine bump and slight colour variation (a dark green or oxblood paint), visible frame mouldings; glass with IOR 1.52 and a faint reflection of the street lamps and the buildings opposite

changes.expected: Texture visible on the facade under the raking lamp; soft reflections over the lower panes

changes.problem: The recessed door is a black void, so the entrance doesn't invite.

change.setting: door downlight (plain description, or a sconce in the vestibule)
change.from: a single narrow spot reaching only the floor
change.to: a 2400 K wall sconce or a wider 60 deg downlight at the door, about 30 W, plus a glazed door with the room glowing through

changes.expected: The vestibule walls and door are legible in warm light, median around 15-25

changes.problem: There is no context and no life: black edges, no neighbours, no people.

change.to: the edge of the neighbouring building with its own dim window on the left, a parked bicycle or street tree in the soft foreground, one or two motion-blurred figures inside at the bar; a thin haze outside at 0.005 per metre so the street lamps bloom

changes.expected: The frame reads as a real street with depth from foreground to the room

out_of_scope.why: The weaknesses are all set, light, material and camera; the products are not the problem in this frame (they are simply not visible).
